entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="じゃあなんだ、お前は本物のワルってわけか？" t="So you a real gangster, huh?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="じゃあなんだ、お前は本物のワルってわけか？" t="Deci ești un gangster adevărat, ha?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="当たり前でしょ！ 仲間を売らず、きっちり務めあげてシャバに戻ってきた" t="That I am, heh heh! One who don't talk, who took his rap, then did his time, heh heh." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="当たり前でしょ！ 仲間を売らず、きっちり務めあげてシャバに戻ってきた" t="Așa sunt, heh heh! Unul care nu vorbește, care și-a luat pedeapsa, apoi și-a ispășit timpul, heh heh." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="へえ？ ケンジはお前がそっこう口を割って刑を逃れたって言ってたがな" t="Oh yeah? 'Cause Kenji says you cleaned up your act so good, your ass is itchin'." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="へえ？ ケンジはお前がそっこう口を割って刑を逃れたって言ってたがな" t="Oh, da? Pentru că Kenji zice că te-ai curățat atât de bine, că te mănâncă fundul." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="え？ ち、ちがう！私は2年もムショにいたんだ！ ケンジの奴、デタラメばっか言って…！" t="Who, m-me? N-no way, choom! I did two years! Kenji's a fuckin' liar!" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="え？ ち、ちがう！私は2年もムショにいたんだ！ ケンジの奴、デタラメばっか言って…！" t="Cine, e-eu? N-nici vorbă, choom! Am făcut doi ani! Kenji e un mincinos al dracului!" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="そうか。じゃあ、直接言ってやりな。明日、街に来るからよ" t="Well, he'll be in town tomorrow. You can tell him yourself." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="そうか。じゃあ、直接言ってやりな。明日、街に来るからよ" t="Ei bine, mâine e în oraș. Poți să-i spui chiar tu." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="え？ そ、それは無理よ。用事があって…" t="W-what? N-nah, choom, I gotta delta…" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="え？ そ、それは無理よ。用事があって…" t="C-ce? N-nu, choom, trebuie s-o tai…" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="どこにも行かせねえよ" t="You're staying with us." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="どこにも行かせねえよ" t="Rămâi cu noi." b="" a=""/>
